{{Quote|We had seen our snowspeeder pilots perform maneuvers every day in the simulators, before the speeders had been adapted to the cold. But we had never seen the full squadron in flight, and it was a heartening sight.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]], regarding the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>}}
The '''snowspeeder''' was a modified version of [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]]. Adapted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] for combat duty on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], snowspeeders were integral to the Alliance's defence of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

==Description==
{{Quote|That armor's too strong for blasters. Rogue Group, use your harpoons and tow cables. Go for the legs. It might be our only chance of stopping them.|Commander Luke Skywalker|<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
[[File:T47airspeeder_schem.jpg|thumb|left|180px|T-47 schematics.]]
Snowspeeders were [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]], heavily modified by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] to operate in cold weather. The wedge-shaped craft were intended to operate in low [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]<ref name="EGVV" /> and measured 5.3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length.<ref name="NEGVV" />

A pair of [[Karydee]] [[KD49 repulsorlift drive unit]]s<ref name="SWCV" /> powered the craft, with one mounted on either side of the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]],<ref name="EGVV" /> alongside two [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[5i.2 high-powered ion drive afterburner]]s.<ref name="SWCV" /> The circuitry for the drives was left exposed,<ref name="EGVV" /> or behind quick-release panels,<ref name="FF28" /> allowing easy access to vital system by technicians performing repairs and maintenance.<ref name="EGVV" /> Snowspeeders were capable of reaching a maximum speed of 1,100 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]],<ref name="NEGVV" /> with an effective combat speed of six hundred kilometers an hour.<ref name="EGVV" />

Mechanical braking flaps were located above each repulsorlift [[Engine/Legends|engine]], deploying during flight to assist in maneuvering.<ref name="EGVV" /> [[Intake]]s and [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|exhaust ports]] were hidden under dust covers, and insulation systems were added to handle extreme cold.<ref name="SWS" /> Additional [[repulsor-coil heater]]s had to be installed to prevent the motors from freezing up, and deicing nozzels were installed underneath the braking and turning flaps<ref name="EGVV" /> to prevent a build up of ice forming on the surfaces.<ref name="FF28" /> The technicians also discovered that the [[radiator fin]]s at the rear of the craft were too efficient in dispersing the heat of its [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]],<ref name="SWCV" /> keeping the engines too cool to operate in the cold environment of Hoth.<ref name="FF28" /> This caused the generators to lock up completely. The technicians attempted to bypass the radiator fins, but when that proved unsuccessful, they settled for insulating each of the fins. This worked to dampen their effectiveness and keep the engines running warm to allow them to function.<ref name="SWCV" />

[[File:Snowspeeder_TCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Rebel Alliance snowspeeder]]
Snowspeeders were equipped with heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating, coated and angled to provide the craft with maximum shot deflection.<ref name="SWS" /> The craft lacked [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], relying on its small size, speed, and maneuverability to survive during combat.<ref name="EGVV" /> Rebel snowspeeders were armed with two forward-facing heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]],<ref name="SWS" /> with one located on either side of the cockpit.<ref name="EGVV" /> The laser cannons were either a pair of [[Mk 4e/S laser cannon]]s,<ref name="SWMBC" /> a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[Ap/11 double laser cannon]],<ref name="SWCV" /> or two [[X2-100 laser cannon]]s.<ref name="DualLaserCannon" /> The weapons were bolted onto the T-47's wings, along with external [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]] and a [[Laser generator/Legends|laser generator]] system. The lasers were connected to the airspeeder's powerful generators. Snowspeeders were also equipped with a rear-facing [[power harpoon launcher]] outfitted with a high-tension tow cable and [[fusion disk]].<ref name="SWS" /> The harpoon launcher was either a [[Mk 1e/S power harpoon]]<ref name="SWMBC" /> or a [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]]<ref name="FF115" /> [[Mo/Dk power harpoon/Legends|Mo/Dk power harpoon]].<ref name="SWCV" />

The [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of the snowspeeder was replaced with one modified from a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]], allowing the Rebel flight crew to adapt to the vehicle without extra training.<ref name="SWS" /> The cockpit canopy featured a polarized view screen.<ref name="SWCV" /> The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] sat facing forward in control of the craft, while the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] sat in the rear-facing seat.<ref name="SWS" /> Computerized targeting systems and [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] projection displays allowed the gunner to control the forward cannons and the rear launcher, although the pilot could take control of the forward lasers if they wanted to.<ref name="NEGVV" /> The targeting systems were linked to [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and [[homing scanner]]s located at the front of the craft. Due to the cramped cockpit, the snowspeeder was only capable of storing two emergency [[Survival pack (Alliance)|survival packs]] and some [[detonator charge]]s.<ref name="FF28" />

==History==
[[File:Hoth_Operations.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rebel snowspeeders launch from Echo Base on Hoth.]]
Snowspeeders were the product of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] program to adapt [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] for military use in hostile environments.<ref name="SWS" /> When the Alliance relocated to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], they began adapting their motor pool to operate in the frozen environment, including a number of [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]].<ref name="NEGVV" /> Snowspeeders were fast, agile and heavily armed, and were major support for ground-fighting actions.<ref name="SWS" />

Snowspeeders were the Alliance's primary defense during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Although knowing that the modified vehicles did not stand much of a chance against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] fought a successful delaying action that allowed Alliance leaders and significant number of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base's]] personnel to escape. During the battle, Rogue Squadron used an innovative combat tactic devised by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[tactician]] [[Beryl Chiffonage]]. Using the snowspeeder's power harpoon, they intended to wrap the tow cable around a [[Walker/Legends|walker's]] legs and trip the war machine over. The tactic was successfully used by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] during the engagement.<ref name="EGVV" />

The Rebel twins [[Tia (pilot)|Tia]] and [[Ghia]] piloted a T-47 during [[Jabba's demolition games]].<ref name="Demolition">''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MarkHamillSnowspeeder-TESB-BTS.png|thumb|right|300px|[[Mark Hamill]] within the snowspeeder prop]]
[[Kenner Products]] released a snowspeeder vehicle based on the one [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] pilots in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|pack=Rebel Armored Snowspeeder|link=vintSnowspeeder.asp}}</ref>

Early concept art from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' played with the idea of snowspeeders being built from [[T-65 X-wing starfighter|X-Wing]] and Y-Wing parts.<ref name="Saga">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'' Disc Eight: Star Wars Archives: Episodes IV-VI</ref>

In the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]], snowspeeders were the Rebel Alliance's special unit, built at [[Fortress/Legends|Fortresses]] for a cost of 55 units of food and 66 units of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]]. They were upgradeable to armored airspeeders. They are provided to the player during Rebel Alliance ''The Battle of Hoth'' mission and may be built at other times during the campaign.<ref name="SWGB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
